description:
Activate the Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
Eloise's and Ulvenwald Mysteries' second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Eloise trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Ulvenwald Mysteries trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Clue ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Human Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Eloise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve Eloise's first trigger, causing you to investigate.
 Resolve Eloise's second trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.
